I read quite a bit. This is an arbitrary subset of some of the best works I've come across.

[Ordered chronologically, oldest to newest.]{.rl-key}

::: {.reading-list}
- [The Iliad]{.book} [by Homer · c. 8th century BCE]{.by}
- [Don Quixote]{.book} [by Miguel de Cervantes · 1605–1615]{.by}
- [The Autobiography of Benjamin Franklin]{.book} [by Benjamin Franklin · 1791]{.by}
- [Self-Reliance]{.book} [by Ralph Waldo Emerson · 1841]{.by}
- [Middlemarch]{.book} [by George Eliot · 1871–1872]{.by}
- [Anna Karenina]{.book} [by Leo Tolstoy · 1875–1877]{.by}
- [The Death of Ivan Ilyich]{.book} [by Leo Tolstoy · 1886]{.by}
- [Civilization and Its Discontents]{.book} [by Sigmund Freud · 1930]{.by}
- [Brave New World]{.book} [by Aldous Huxley · 1932]{.by}
- [East of Eden]{.book} [by John Steinbeck · 1952]{.by}
- [The Lessons of History]{.book} [by Will and Ariel Durant · 1968]{.by}
- [The Denial of Death]{.book} [by Ernest Becker · 1973]{.by}
- [Gödel, Escher, Bach]{.book} [by Douglas Hofstadter · 1979]{.by}
- [Surely You're Joking, Mr. Feynman!]{.book} [by Richard P. Feynman · 1985]{.by}
- [Chaos]{.book} [by James Gleick · 1987]{.by}
- [The War of Art]{.book} [by Steven Pressfield · 2002]{.by}
- [Deep Work]{.book} [by Cal Newport · 2016]{.by}
- [Principles]{.book} [by Ray Dalio · 2017]{.by}
- [Four Thousand Weeks]{.book} [by Oliver Burkeman · 2021]{.by}
:::
